prompt_fragment:

Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
Three overlapping penguin silhouettes — a huddle reduced to essential
curves, no faces, no detail.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon on off-white canvas (#E7E3D5), generous padding, centered composition. Three overlapping adult emperor penguin silhouettes arranged in a tight huddle — tall, lean, narrow-bodied forms reduced to essential upright curves, no facial features, no interior detail. Front penguin rendered in burnt sienna (#D97742), middle penguin in deep crimson (#B04646), rear penguin in warm sand (#C9A96B). Silhouettes stack with deliberate offset layering, each a clean bold vector shape. Foreground figure reads as the dominant mass; overlapping edges crisp and precise. Flat fills, sharp geometry, zero texture, zero brushwork, fully readable at 16px.
